install:
if ! command -v godot >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/godot.zip https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7-stable/Godot_v4.7-stable_linux.x86_64.zip && unzip -o /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp && sudo mv /tmp/Godot_v4.7-stable_linux.x86_64 /usr/local/bin/godot && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/godot; fi
godot --headless --import
